title: Workout file, schema_version 1
description: One workout. See docs/DATA_FORMAT.md. This schema describes what the app writes; the app reads a documented superset (e.g. null treated as absent, unit aliases). Unknown properties are allowed everywhere and must be preserved by writers.

started_at.description: When the workout started, local wall-clock time with its UTC offset.

bodyweight.description: Body weight on the day, used for bodyweight-inclusive volume.

exercises.description: Exercises in the order performed. May be empty.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time with mandatory offset (Z or ±HH:MM). Uppercase T and Z.

value.description: May be negative only for assisted exercises (assistance subtracts from body weight).

name.description: Exercise name as it should be displayed. Always present so the file is readable without the exercise library.

sets.description: Sets in the order performed. May be empty.

set.description: One set. Must record at least one of reps, duration_s, distance.

warmup.description: Warm-up set; excluded from PRs, volume and progression. Omitted means false.

reps.description: Completed reps. 0 records a failed attempt.

weight.description: External load. Omitted means none recorded.

rpe.description: Rate of perceived exertion, 1-10, halves allowed.

rest_s.description: Rest taken after this set, in seconds.
